international.title: Big wave surfers line up to ride ‘raw power of the Pacific’ during Super El-Niño swells
international.summary: Fans of the sport dubbed the event ‘Monster Day’ as pro surfers tackled the storm-driven waves at Mavericks Beach While this year’s Super El Niño storms are battering the California coast and destroying homes and infrastructure, surfers are finding a silver lining: waves so epic that pro athletes from around the world are making last-minute journeys to experience them. Big wave surfers converged on northern California this Saturday to ride massive, storm-driven swells at the famously dangerous Mavericks Beach, an event some surf fans called “Monster Day.” Continue reading...
